easy.def: To have to give something back.
examples: I owe you a dollar.
Mia owes Sam a favor.
We owe the library a book.

more.def: To have to pay or give back something you have been lent or given.
examples: I owe my brother five dollars.
We owe the library for the late book.
She owes me a favor for helping her.

easy.def: A bird that comes out at night.
examples: The owl hoots.
An owl has big eyes.
The owl sat in a tree.

more.def: A bird with big eyes that hunts at night and makes a hooting sound.
examples: The owl hooted from the tree.
An owl can turn its head far around.
The owl swooped down on a mouse.
The owlet sat in the nest.
An owlet is a young owl.
The owlet blinked.
The fluffy owlet sat in the nest.
An owlet learns to fly in a few weeks.
The owlet blinked its big eyes.

easy.def: Belonging to you and no one else.
examples: I have my own room.
She made her own lunch.
This is my own pen.

more.def: Belonging to one person or thing and not to anyone else.
examples: Each child has a cubby with her own name on it.
He built his own kite from paper and sticks.
The cat has its own bed by the window.

easy.def: To have something that is yours.
examples: I own a bike.
She owns two cats.
Who owns this hat?

more.def: To have something that belongs to you.
examples: My uncle owns a small farm with chickens and goats.
Our family owns a boat that we keep at the dock.
Who owns the dog that was barking next door?

related.def: To say something or someone is no longer yours.

examples: The dog's owner came.
Who is the owner?
The shop owner smiled.

more.def: A person who owns something, such as a pet, shop or house.
examples: The dog's owner threw the ball.
The shop owner greeted every customer.
The owner of the bike left it by the gate.
Ownership of the dog is mine.
He proved his ownership.
Who has ownership?

more.def: The fact of owning something, or having something that belongs to you.
examples: The papers showed who had ownership of the old house.
Taking ownership of a pet means you must feed and care for it.
Ownership of the bike passed to my little sister.
